PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Durable current hazard, constraint and decision state
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Military/aerospace hazard tracking, process hazard records and safety-case/hazard-log practice.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Preserve each material hazard, causal scenarios, controls/constraints, evidence, owner, residual decision and current status across the lifecycle.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Hazards are repeatedly rediscovered, lost at handoff or marked closed while controls/evidence/configuration change.
PROPERTIES.LOSS_OR_HAZARD: Known hazard reappears or remains uncontrolled because organisational memory and decision status are stale or fragmented.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Spreadsheet rot, duplicate IDs, ambiguous closure, no consumer, status without evidence and poor configuration/change linkage.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Maintain the minimum durable state needed to understand current hazard/control/acceptance closure; update through change and retire obsolete entries explicitly.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Long-lived, multi-team or regulated systems and hazards requiring multiple controls/decisions over time.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: A local ephemeral hazard fully eliminated and verified can be recorded in the ordinary work item; a dedicated log is unnecessary.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Clear semantics, ownership, configuration identity, change triggers and a live decision consumer.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_OR_CONTROL_PRECONDITIONS: Hazard/control owners and acceptance authority must be named; unresolved hazards cannot disappear through administrative closure.
PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_FEEDBACK_OR_OBSERVABILITY: Control/evidence status, owner/acceptance, configuration, open scenarios, incidents, changes and review/expiry dates.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Provides continuity, impact analysis, accountability and prevents silent loss of safety knowledge.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: System safety, design/change authority, operator, assessor and risk acceptor.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Hazard-log bureaucracy, entry count as quality, stale closure, generic hazards, duplicate analysis and detached spreadsheets.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: No log establishes hazard completeness or control effectiveness; it can become a powerful compliance theatre.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved toward model-linked, configuration-aware, consumer-driven hazard/constraint state with automated staleness and orphan checks.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Preserve current decision-relevant hazard/control memory in any implementation that exposes ownership, evidence, assumptions, change and residual acceptance.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A spreadsheet or prescribed schema is not required; durable current semantic state is.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Integrated verification that a safety control achieves the intended state
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: System test/IV&V, functional-safety verification, control-theoretic feedback and end-to-end protection testing.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Verify the full path from hazard trigger through controller/action/interface/actuation/process response/feedback, not only each component or command.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Every component passes its own test while the composed control fails in timing, units, mode, authority or physical effect.
PROPERTIES.LOSS_OR_HAZARD: Hazard remains or recurs despite nominally verified requirements and components.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Mocked interfaces, shared test oracle, unrealistic environment, untested failure/degraded modes and command-echo feedback.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Derive end-to-end acceptance criteria from the safety constraint, exercise representative normal/fault/transition scenarios and confirm physical/system state.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Consequential interlocks, shutdown, autonomous control, recovery and multi-component protective functions.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: A single local direct test suffices when the control path is simple, fully observable and reversible.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Testable state criteria, representative configuration/environment, safe test containment and independent observation where warranted.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_OR_CONTROL_PRECONDITIONS: Verification authority needs access across component/organisational boundaries and power to block acceptance.
PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_FEEDBACK_OR_OBSERVABILITY: Trigger, command, timing, actuation, process state, feedback semantics, degraded modes and post-control stability.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Finds integration and interface hazards that component evidence cannot establish away.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Integrator, operator, verifier/IV&V, safety case owner and acceptance authority.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Unsafe testing, unrepresentative simulation, test-only instrumentation, excessive scenario sets and confusing test completion with field assurance.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Testing cannot cover all interactions and formal/model evidence is still needed for rare or dangerous states.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved toward scenario/model-based end-to-end verification, hardware/software-in-the-loop, operational monitoring and claim-linked evidence.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A control is accepted only when current evidence shows that it drives and maintains the intended safe process state under relevant conditions.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A test report is not the property; hazard-linked state achievement and feedback confirmation are.

CONSEQUENCE_REVERSIBILITY_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: A control is accepted only when current evidence shows that it drives and maintains the intended safe process state under relevant conditions.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Safety management of lifecycle transitions and temporary configurations
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Military system-safety lifecycle programmes, nuclear commissioning/decommissioning and process modification/start-up practice.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Analyse and control hazards unique to assembly, installation, commissioning, migration, maintenance, start-up, shutdown and decommissioning.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Only steady-state operation is assured although temporary configurations remove barriers, alter authority and create nonroutine interfaces.
PROPERTIES.LOSS_OR_HAZARD: Loss during transition, test, construction, maintenance or retirement when normal controls are absent or roles/configurations are ambiguous.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Temporary power/logic, incomplete systems, parallel old/new control, handoff, latent energy/material, unfamiliar work and restart pressure.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Define transition states and hazards, sequence controls, temporary barriers/authority, hold points, configuration verification and exit/recovery criteria.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: High-consequence installation, major upgrade, migration, maintenance outage, commissioning or decommissioning.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Routine local reversible transitions with an established direct check use the ordinary procedure and observation.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Transition plan/state model, temporary configuration identity, competent coordination and restoration/rollback path.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_OR_CONTROL_PRECONDITIONS: A transition controller must have cross-boundary authority and explicit handoff/hold-point release; normal operations authority may be insufficient.
PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_FEEDBACK_OR_OBSERVABILITY: Temporary configuration, barrier availability, sequence/hold point, personnel/authority, tests, residual energy/material and exit criteria.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Closes a recurrent blind spot where the system is most coupled, least familiar and least protected.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Project/commissioning manager, operator, maintenance, supplier/contractor and safety authority.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Plan ceremony, excessive hold points, outdated procedures, transition fatigue and informal workarounds caused by impractical sequencing.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Transition models can be incomplete and over-control can prolong exposure to a temporary hazardous state.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved toward explicit transitional configurations, integrated readiness evidence, staged cutover, rollback and decommissioning hazard closure.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Treat every materially different lifecycle state as a real system configuration with its own hazards, controls, feedback and authorised exit criteria.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A commissioning checklist is domain-specific; controlled transitional-state reasoning is the property.

EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_STRENGTH: HIGH — origin and transmission are documented in primary or authoritative historical sources.
EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.FORMAL_OR_MODEL_STRENGTH: HIGH_FOR_REPRESENTATION_MODERATE_FOR_EFFECTIVENESS — control theory cleanly represents constraints, actions and feedback; comparative outcome evidence remains limited.
EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.ACCIDENT_CASE_STRENGTH: MODERATE — multiple cases exhibit the mechanism, but case evidence is not a controlled estimate of effect size.
EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_STRENGTH: LOW_TO_MODERATE — controlled or comparative field evidence is uneven across domains.
EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.DOMAIN_PRACTICE_STRENGTH: HIGH — established in mature high-consequence practice when properly scoped.
EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.STANDARD_OR_REGULATORY_STRENGTH: HIGH — required or recognised in one or more authoritative regimes; this is practice authority, not optimality proof.
EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH: MODERATE_TO_HIGH — mechanism transfers when the same hazard/control conditions exist; artefacts do not automatically transfer.
EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY: HIGH — value depends on boundary, model, data, authority, independence and current configuration.
EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE_STRENGTH: MODERATE — implementation failures and scope critiques materially constrain use.
EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.SOURCE_BASIS: Primary: S012, S054, S060, S095, S103; critical/contrary: S058, S073.

PROPERTIES.EMPIRICAL_OR_DOMAIN_EVIDENCE: Strong nuclear/process/military lifecycle practice; comparative evidence for exact transition governance is limited.
PROPERTIES.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Additional hold points can increase time in vulnerable configurations and may be bypassed under schedule pressure.
PROPERTIES.OPEN_QUESTIONS: How should transition assurance minimise both premature progression and prolonged exposure to temporary risk?

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Risk-matrix cell treated as objective risk or sufficient decision evidence
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Later administrative simplification of qualitative/semiquantitative risk assessment; not the whole historical risk-analysis tradition.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Assign ordinal severity and likelihood categories, often multiply or combine them, colour a cell and treat its rank as the risk.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: The matrix suppresses uncertainty, dependence, exposure and category sensitivity while authorising consequential decisions.
PROPERTIES.LOSS_OR_HAZARD: Misprioritised or accepted hazards, particularly rare catastrophic risks, through false precision and ranking inversion.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Ordinal arithmetic, arbitrary bins, range compression, poor calibration, threshold gaming and incomparable risk mechanisms.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Reject the cell as truth; preserve only the weaker property of explicit consequence/uncertainty discrimination and use a representation matched to the decision.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: At most as a transparent workshop prompt or coarse triage aid where rankings are not treated as quantitative or dispositive.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use direct constraints, separate consequence/uncertainty narratives, sensitivity analysis or quantitative models with defensible data instead.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Users must understand the representation limits, disclose category choices and retain authority to override rankings.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_OR_CONTROL_PRECONDITIONS: No authority should accept catastrophic residual risk solely from a colour or product score.
PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_FEEDBACK_OR_OBSERVABILITY: Sensitivity to bins, uncertainty, exposure denominator, dependence and whether the ranking changes under plausible alternatives.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: A matrix may aid communication but supplies no general objective-risk property.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Risk analyst, decision owner and workshop participants.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: False precision, inversion, range compression, category gaming, low-frequency underestimation and “red-to-yellow” paperwork controls.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Mathematical and regulatory critiques directly undermine universal ranking validity; prevalence and standard use are not effectiveness proof.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Later practice increasingly treats matrices as limited aids, supplements them with uncertainty and consequence constraints, or replaces them.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY in the claim that a matrix score is risk; retain explicit, uncertainty-aware and decision-linked risk representation instead.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: The coloured grid is optional ceremony and becomes harmful when it substitutes for evidence or judgement.

EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_STRENGTH: HIGH — the practice or simplification is well documented.
EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.FORMAL_OR_MODEL_STRENGTH: LOW_OR_NEGATIVE — the claimed inference is invalid or materially underdetermined.
EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.ACCIDENT_CASE_STRENGTH: MODERATE_TO_HIGH_AGAINST — accident evidence supplies counterexamples.
EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_STRENGTH: MODERATE_AGAINST_OR_UNRESOLVED — available studies do not justify the universal claim.
EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.DOMAIN_PRACTICE_STRENGTH: PRESENT_AS_CEREMONY_OR_SHORTCUT — prevalence does not establish value.
EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.STANDARD_OR_REGULATORY_STRENGTH: VARIABLE — some artefacts appear in standards, but the rejected inference is not warranted.
EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH: LOW_OR_NONE — no general property is admitted in this form.
EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY: VERY_HIGH — apparent validity usually depends on hidden assumptions.
EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE_STRENGTH: HIGH — theory, cases or empirical studies directly undermine the universal claim.
EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.SOURCE_BASIS: Primary: S034, S036, S037, S038; critical/contrary: S036, S037, S038.

PROPERTIES.EMPIRICAL_OR_DOMAIN_EVIDENCE: Formal/mathematical critiques and HSE pitfall evidence are strong; matrices remain widely used as communication devices.
PROPERTIES.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: Some tailored matrices may support bounded prioritisation, but that does not rescue the objective or sufficient-evidence claim.
PROPERTIES.OPEN_QUESTIONS: Under what narrow conditions can a matrix improve communication without becoming a threshold-gaming authority?

RISK_REPRESENTATION_PROFILE.WHAT_IT_CANNOT_JUSTIFY: Objective risk, valid arithmetic ranking, precise probability, acceptable residual risk or control sufficiency.

RISK_REPRESENTATION_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: Do not treat a matrix score as truth; use decision-linked consequence and uncertainty reasoning.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Maximal safety process on every change
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Bureaucratic overextension of certification and stage-gate practices rather than a defensible historical system-safety principle.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Require the same full hazard analyses, boards, evidence and re-certification regardless of consequence, reversibility, scope or existing discriminator.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Low-value ritual consumes scarce expertise, delays safety fixes and encourages undeclared workarounds while adding no decision information.
PROPERTIES.LOSS_OR_HAZARD: Secondary harm from unavailable service, frozen defects, attention dilution or bypass; no demonstrated reduction in the trivial target risk.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Label-based triggers, fear of audit, inability to reuse evidence and incentives rewarding process volume.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Replace with change-impact analysis and consequence/reversibility/coupling tailoring; re-establish only affected claims and escalate uncertainty.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: No general trigger. Deep process is warranted only where credible consequence, coupling, irreversibility, novelty or weak observability makes it informative.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use the cheap authoritative check for local reversible work and ordinary peer/change control for routine bounded work.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Reliable change classification, current baseline, deterministic discriminators where claimed and escalation authority.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_OR_CONTROL_PRECONDITIONS: Safety/change authority must be able to tailor down as well as up without hiding significant change.
PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_FEEDBACK_OR_OBSERVABILITY: Decision changes, defects found, false-stop/delay cost, workaround rate and whether affected safety claims were actually re-established.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: No general payoff; proportional process is the retained property.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Change authority, delivery team and safety/risk owner.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Checklist proliferation, long queues, shadow changes, stale assumptions preserved by process inertia and high false-positive cost.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Official guidance explicitly supports tailoring and affected-scope assessment; maximality has no cross-domain optimality evidence.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Modern practice moves toward incremental, objectives-driven and risk-informed assurance with bounded reuse and cheap paths.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY in uniform maximal treatment; apply only the control depth needed to discriminate and control the credible loss.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Universal full-process templates are ceremony, not safety.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Compliance or certification treated as proof of current system safety
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Proxy/compliance gaming arising around mature standards and certification regimes; not the stated purpose of system safety itself.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Infer that a system is safe now because required objectives, reviews or certificates were once accepted.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Certification scope, assumptions, configuration and operational change are ignored, and compliance replaces live hazard control.
PROPERTIES.LOSS_OR_HAZARD: Loss in an accepted system whose actual interactions, organisation, configuration or operations fall outside or contradict the evidence.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Scope gaps, prescriptive minimums, stale evidence, delegated responsibility, regulator capture and inability to observe operation.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Treat compliance as one bounded evidence source; preserve current configuration/assumptions, operational monitoring, change impact and residual-risk authority.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Certification is relevant where law/domain requires it, but never sufficient for total current safety.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For nonregulated low-consequence work use direct engineering evidence rather than importing certification ceremony.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Accurate scope, current evidence, configuration identity, operational controls and independent challenge.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_OR_CONTROL_PRECONDITIONS: Operator/design authority retains responsibility; a certificate does not transfer control of ongoing risk.
PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_FEEDBACK_OR_OBSERVABILITY: Operational anomalies, changes, control/barrier health, assumptions and evidence validity after acceptance.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Certification can coordinate minimum evidence and public authority, but the universal proof inference has no payoff.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Regulator/certifier, operator, design authority and public risk governance.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Tick-box compliance, scope laundering, certification freeze, paper safety and suppressed post-certification evidence.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Nimrod, Columbia, 737 MAX and other investigations supply direct counterexamples to acceptance equalling current safety.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved practice emphasises continuing airworthiness/operation, living cases, change-aware assurance and explicit certification limits.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Certification is a bounded governance/evidence decision, not a guarantee that all hazards are identified, controlled or unchanged.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: The certificate is domain-specific; current hazard/control/evidence integrity is the property.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Zero observed incidents treated as proof that controls work
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Lagging-metric simplification in industrial and organisational safety management.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Use a short incident-free period or low count as sufficient evidence of low true risk and effective controls.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Rare-event statistics, exposure, underreporting and latent degradation make silence compatible with high risk.
PROPERTIES.LOSS_OR_HAZARD: Catastrophic loss after a period interpreted as safe despite weak controls or precursors.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Low base rate, changing denominator, reporting suppression, luck, survivorship bias and hidden near misses.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Reject the inference; combine incident data with exposure, control/barrier health, precursors, assumptions and causal evidence.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Incident counts may contribute to trend analysis only with adequate exposure/definition and never stand alone for rare catastrophic hazards.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use direct inspections/tests/control-state measures or an authoritative deterministic discriminator where available.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Stable reporting and exposure definitions, enough data and a model linking outcomes to controls.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_OR_CONTROL_PRECONDITIONS: Decision owners must be able to investigate weak signals rather than reward zero-report targets.
PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_FEEDBACK_OR_OBSERVABILITY: Exposure-adjusted events, near misses, reporting quality, barrier demand/success and precursor trends.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: No general proof payoff; outcome data are one evidence stream.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Safety management, operator and risk authority.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Incentive to suppress reports, celebratory complacency, regression to the mean and delayed detection of latent risk.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Sparse catastrophic data cannot validate absence of risk; leading indicators also have validity/gaming limits.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Modern practice uses precursors, control-state monitoring and multiple evidence streams while treating incident counts cautiously.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY in incident-free proof; require evidence proportionate to rarity, exposure and causal control state.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Zero-incident boards and targets are potentially harmful ceremony when they suppress learning.

EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.FORMAL_OR_MODEL_STRENGTH: LOW_OR_NEGATIVE — the claimed inference is invalid or materially underdetermined.

EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.SOURCE_BASIS: Primary: S039, S080, S097, S104; critical/contrary: S071, S072, S081, S082.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Human error used as the root-cause endpoint
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Early accident prevention and blame-oriented investigation simplification, later explicitly criticised by human-factors and systems safety.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Conclude that an operator made an error or violated a procedure and close with retraining, discipline or reminder.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: The label redescribes the unsafe action but does not explain information, workload, design, goals, authority or defences that made it possible.
PROPERTIES.LOSS_OR_HAZARD: Recurring loss because the same system conditions continue to elicit or fail to tolerate predictable human variability.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Hindsight bias, outcome bias, local-rationality blindness, unusable automation/procedures and blame incentives.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Reject human error as terminal cause; investigate the action in context, preserve individual competence/accountability questions separately, and change upstream controls.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Human action remains relevant as a causal event but not as a self-explanatory root cause.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For an unambiguous deliberate violation under adequate conditions, ordinary accountability may apply, but still test whether system controls were sufficient.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Access to work context, human-factors competence and a fair learning/accountability process.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_OR_CONTROL_PRECONDITIONS: Investigators and managers must be able to change design/organisation, not merely discipline the nearest actor.
PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_FEEDBACK_OR_OBSERVABILITY: Interface/mode/workload evidence, feedback, competing goals, procedure usability, staffing, prior signals and recurrence.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: No payoff as an endpoint; contextual action analysis is retained.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Investigator, designer, operator management and just-culture authority.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Blame displacement, shallow retraining, underreporting and removal of useful operator discretion.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Systems approaches can overcorrect by erasing culpable misconduct or individual skill duties; accountability and explanation are distinct.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved through Reason/local rationality, just culture and system-control analysis toward context-sensitive causal mechanisms.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Human action is analysed as part of a sociotechnical control system; “error” alone never closes causal or corrective-action burdens.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A Swiss-cheese or human-error taxonomy is optional; context/control evidence is required.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: More redundancy treated as automatically safer
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Reliability engineering simplification and architectural rule-of-thumb detached from common-cause and interaction analysis.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Add duplicate components/channels and infer safety improvement from nominal multiplicity.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Shared design, requirements, software, sensors, utilities, maintenance or environment creates correlated failure; complexity creates new interactions.
PROPERTIES.LOSS_OR_HAZARD: Catastrophic common-mode loss, conflicting outputs, hidden latent failure or unsafe arbitration despite multiple channels.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Invalid independence assumption, identical software/specification, common sensor/data, coupling, voting defects and maintenance-induced correlation.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Reject automaticity; state the hazard and redundancy purpose, analyse common cause/dependence, use diversity where informative, monitor degradation and test arbitration.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Redundancy is justified where continued/backup function materially controls a hazard and credible independence can be evidenced.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: A simpler single channel with strong elimination/containment and direct verification may be safer for low-complexity hazards.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Explicit failure/interaction model, independence evidence, diagnostic coverage and manageable complexity.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_OR_CONTROL_PRECONDITIONS: Architecture authority must own the tradeoff and operations must restrict use when redundant capacity is degraded.
PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_FEEDBACK_OR_OBSERVABILITY: Common inputs, latent channel state, disagreement, voting/arbitration, shared maintenance/utilities and demand success.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Redundancy can improve tolerance, but there is no general property that more is always safer.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Architect, reliability/system safety, verifier and operator.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Common-mode failure, mode confusion, latent fault accumulation, false confidence and complexity-induced defects.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Multiversion experiments, Ariane/Fukushima/737 evidence and systems theory directly refute naive independence.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved toward function-specific independence/diversity claims, common-cause analysis, degradation monitoring and simpler architectures where appropriate.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use the minimum architecture that controls the hazard with demonstrable independence and manageable interaction complexity.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Channel count is ceremony without hazard purpose, independence and health evidence.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Reviewer or evidence-item count treated as assurance strength
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Compliance metric and organisational-independence simplification around review, audit and safety-case practice.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Infer stronger assurance from more signatures, reviews, documents, tests or evidence items without analysing information content and dependence.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Correlated evidence and confirmation bias are hidden by volume, while scarce challenge effort is spread thinly.
PROPERTIES.LOSS_OR_HAZARD: Unsafe acceptance despite extensive review because all projections share one flawed premise, oracle or incentive.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Copied artefacts, common requirements/model, review fatigue, authority gradients and metric incentives.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Reject count as strength; map what each evidence item can detect, its provenance/dependence and whether review changed a consequential decision.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Additional review is justified only when it contributes distinct competence, evidence or challenge proportional to consequence.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: One decisive direct check is enough for a narrow reversible claim; avoid reviewer multiplication.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Explicit claim/evidence model, provenance, competence and challenge authority.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_OR_CONTROL_PRECONDITIONS: Independent reviewers need access and escalation, but the acceptance authority must judge informational contribution rather than headcount.
PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_FEEDBACK_OR_OBSERVABILITY: Distinct findings, shared sources, changed decisions, unresolved dissent, defect yield and review latency/cost.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: No general count-based payoff; evidence independence/diversity is retained.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Assurance owner, IV&V, certifier and risk acceptor.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Signature collection, duplicate test sets, document inflation, delayed feedback and responsibility diffusion.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Experimental independence evidence and Nimrod directly undermine volume/organisational-separation proxies.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved toward confidence arguments, defeaters, evidence provenance and risk-based independent assessment.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Assurance strength depends on relevance, validity, currentness and independently informative failure modes—not artefact or reviewer count.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Review boards and evidence inventories are implementations, not properties.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Complete safety case treated as proof the system is safe
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Misinterpretation of safety-case completeness and certification acceptance.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Infer system truth from a complete, coherent or accepted claim–argument–evidence document.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Arguments can omit hazards, contain false premises, cite dependent/stale evidence or represent a different configuration while remaining coherent.
PROPERTIES.LOSS_OR_HAZARD: Catastrophic operation under persuasive but invalid paper assurance.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Confirmation bias, rhetorical structure, scope omission, evidence mismatch, after-the-fact construction and acceptance pressure.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Reject the inference; retain defeasible claim–evidence reasoning tied to actual configuration, assumptions, counterevidence, operational monitoring and authority.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A safety case is useful for consequential synthesis/acceptance but is never a guarantee.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use a compact rationale/direct evidence for narrow reversible claims rather than manufacturing a full case.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Valid evidence, complete-enough hazard boundary, current configuration, active challenge and live consumer.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_OR_CONTROL_PRECONDITIONS: Acceptance authority must be able to reject the case and reopen it after change or adverse evidence.
PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_FEEDBACK_OR_OBSERVABILITY: Evidence freshness, assumptions, defeaters, system correspondence, operational anomalies and decision use.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Structured reasoning may improve transparency; “complete equals safe” has no general payoff.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Case owner, operator, assessor/regulator and risk acceptor.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Paper safety, template compliance, argumentative overconfidence, stale cases and disconnect from engineering reality.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Nimrod is direct and authoritative counterevidence; safety-case scholars also stress limits and confidence.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved toward modular, living, challenge-led and evidence-provenance-aware assurance.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A case is a defeasible justification for a bounded decision, never a proof that all system hazards are absent or controlled.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: The monolithic completed document is not a general property.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: One universal hazard-analysis technique
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Method advocacy and textbook simplification across FMEA, FTA, HAZOP, STPA and other schools.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Select one named technique and treat it as sufficient for every failure, interaction, process, organisational and uncertainty class.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: The representation systematically excludes relevant causes while analysts mistake worksheet completion for hazard completeness.
PROPERTIES.LOSS_OR_HAZARD: Missed hazard outside the method’s causal vocabulary, assumptions or system boundary.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Bottom-up versus top-down blind spots, static logic, guideword anchoring, analyst subjectivity, model scale and unknown interactions.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Reject universality; select and combine techniques by hazard/causal coverage, consequence and decision need, and state residual blind spots.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Each method triggers only where its representation matches the problem and expected findings can change design or operation.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: A direct deterministic analysis may suffice for a narrow simple hazard; do not run every named method.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Method competence, explicit assumptions/boundary and a coverage/complementarity rationale.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_OR_CONTROL_PRECONDITIONS: Safety authority must choose and tailor methods rather than accept tool/vendor branding.
PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_FEEDBACK_OR_OBSERVABILITY: Hazards/scenarios found, method overlap/gaps, decisions changed, unresolved uncertainty and model/analyst sensitivity.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: No universal-method payoff; deliberate complementarity is retained.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Safety analyst, system architect, human factors/operations and acceptance authority.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Method wars, redundant workshops, inconsistent taxonomies, false completeness and tool-driven scope.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: STPA empirical comparison is limited; FMEA/FTA/HAZOP each have well-established but bounded semantics.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Modern practice hybridises failure, interaction, scenario, process and assurance methods around the actual hazard class.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use the minimum complementary method set needed to represent credible causal classes and make decisions; declare what remains outside.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Named-method ritual is not a property.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Zero-risk or absolute-safety requirement as a general engineering target
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Public rhetoric and overconservative simplification, not mature risk/standards doctrine.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Demand proof of no risk or elimination of every conceivable hazard before operation/change.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Impossible proof burdens obscure residual uncertainty, prevent beneficial/safety-critical service and encourage hidden risk acceptance.
PROPERTIES.LOSS_OR_HAZARD: Secondary loss from unavailable systems or unaddressed comparative risk, plus false claims when zero cannot be demonstrated.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Unbounded system/environment, unknown hazards, finite evidence, competing harms and rhetorical rather than operational criteria.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Reject absolute proof; define unacceptable losses, eliminate/control hazards, state residual risk/uncertainty and apply proportionate authority.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: No general engineering trigger; strict prohibitions may apply to particular intolerable states or legal duties.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use deterministic prohibitions for specific unacceptable states, not a universal claim that all risk is zero.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Explicit loss and tolerance criteria, feasible controls and honest uncertainty.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_OR_CONTROL_PRECONDITIONS: Legitimate public/legal authority defines intolerability; engineers cannot manufacture zero through documentation.
PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_FEEDBACK_OR_OBSERVABILITY: Residual hazards, uncertainty, exposure, alternatives, operational evidence and competing service harms.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: No general payoff as an absolute target; specific loss constraints and ALARP/proportional control are retained.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Public authority, risk acceptor, designer and operator.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Paralysis, risk transfer, dishonest “zero” certification, excessive false stops and suppression of uncertainty.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Standards distinguish safety from freedom from all risk and HSE doctrine explicitly reasons about tolerability/practicability.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Modern evolved form uses explicit unacceptable loss, residual risk and proportionality while preserving categorical constraints where justified.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY in absolute safety; engineer against specified unacceptable losses with bounded evidence and transparent residual uncertainty.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: “Zero risk” slogans are ceremony unless attached to a specific enforceable prohibition.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Generic safety-culture score treated as direct control or safety evidence
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Organisational safety-culture programmes and survey measurement, often detached from specific hazards and decisions.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Measure broad attitudes or perceptions, aggregate a score and infer that control effectiveness or accident risk has improved.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Construct ambiguity, common-method bias and weak causal linkage allow a favourable score alongside degraded barriers and incentives.
PROPERTIES.LOSS_OR_HAZARD: False reassurance, misdirected interventions and suppression of concrete control/authority problems.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Definition proliferation, self-report bias, benchmark gaming, lagging outcomes, local variation and no hazard-linked consumer.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Reject the score as direct evidence; retain observable organisational control, reporting, authority, incentive and barrier mechanisms, using surveys only as one diagnostic input.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A targeted survey can trigger inquiry where a plausible mechanism and consumer exist, not certify safety.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use direct work/control evidence for a known hazard; no culture programme is needed for a simple technical defect.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Defined construct, validated measure, exposure/context, triangulation and authority to act on findings.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_OR_CONTROL_PRECONDITIONS: Leaders must change resources/incentives/controls; communications teams cannot own the safety consequence.
PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_FEEDBACK_OR_OBSERVABILITY: Specific escalation, reporting, staffing, maintenance, waiver and control behaviours plus survey uncertainty.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: No general direct-control payoff; sociotechnical mechanism analysis is retained.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Leadership, workforce, regulator and safety management.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Score chasing, positivity pressure, generic training, survey fatigue and displacement of material hazards.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Reviews find substantial definitional and measurement uncertainty and warn against simple outcome claims.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved toward mixed-method, mechanism-specific organisational diagnostics and hazard-linked leading indicators.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use “culture” only as a hypothesis about observable decision/control patterns, never as self-validating evidence from a composite score.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Swiss-cheese diagram used as an engine-level causal explanation
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: James Reason’s layered-defence metaphor and its widespread textbook transmission.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Represent accidents as hazard trajectories aligning through holes in multiple defence layers.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: The metaphor identifies neither the concrete control action, interaction, timing, feedback, authority nor causal mechanism needed for design.
PROPERTIES.LOSS_OR_HAZARD: Shallow analysis and generic “add another layer” recommendations that miss common cause or dynamic interaction.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Static layers, ambiguous holes, hindsight placement, no state/control semantics and apparent independence.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Retain only the intuition that multiple defences can be breached; replace mechanism claims with explicit barrier dependence, causal scenarios and control/feedback models.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Useful as high-level communication after the actual mechanisms and barrier functions are established.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use a direct causal/control model for engineering decisions; omit the diagram when it adds no consumer value.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Defined hazard, barriers and mechanisms; audience understands metaphor limitations.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_OR_CONTROL_PRECONDITIONS: No special authority; engineering decisions must rest on more specific evidence.
PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_FEEDBACK_OR_OBSERVABILITY: Actual barrier state, dependencies, control actions, timing and causal scenario—not hole count.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Limited communication payoff; no general engine-level analysis property survives in diagram form.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Educator, investigator and communicating authority.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Layer-counting, hidden common cause, blame relocation, generic recommendations and false causal completeness.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Reason’s broader contribution on latent conditions survives, but the popular diagram is often overextended beyond explanatory capacity.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved toward barrier-management, bow-tie and systems/control models with explicit functions, dependencies and feedback.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: SUPERSEDED_BY_STRONGER_FORM for detailed analysis; retain only a bounded communication metaphor subordinate to explicit mechanisms.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: The diagram is not required and should not authorise controls by itself.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: STPA treated as a universal replacement for other hazard analyses
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Overgeneralisation of STAMP/STPA advocacy beyond the method’s supported reformulation and evidence base.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Use STPA for all hazard classes and infer that FMEA, FTA, HAZOP, quantitative reliability and domain analyses are obsolete.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Control-structure modelling can be subjective, large and weak on component probabilities/material mechanisms while comparative effectiveness remains limited.
PROPERTIES.LOSS_OR_HAZARD: Missed failure or process mechanism, excessive analysis burden, or false confidence in a complete control model.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Boundary/model choices, analyst dependence, scalability, validation limits and insufficient domain-specific physical/reliability detail.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Reject universal replacement; retain unsafe-interaction/control reasoning and combine STPA with failure, process, quantitative, human-factors or formal methods as the hazard requires.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: STPA is especially relevant for software-intensive, multi-controller and interaction hazards where its findings have design consumers.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use direct failure analysis or another adequate method for simple bounded hazards; no STPA diagram is obligatory.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Competent modelling, operational participation, bounded system/control scope and complementary coverage rationale.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_OR_CONTROL_PRECONDITIONS: Safety authority chooses the portfolio and must not equate STPA completion with hazard completeness.
PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_FEEDBACK_OR_OBSERVABILITY: Inter-analyst consistency, scenarios/controls found, decisions changed, omitted causal classes, analysis effort and field feedback.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: The universal claim has no established payoff; the interaction/control property is strongly retained.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: System safety, designers, operators and research community.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Diagram explosion, subjective unsafe-action contexts, weak quantitative integration, tool lock-in and method branding.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Reviews and FAA evaluation find promise and useful gaps but call for stronger empirical comparison, scalability evidence and real-world validation.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved toward hybrid STPA–FTA/FMEA/formal/scenario workflows and narrower claims about representational contribution.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: CONTESTED as a universal method; retain STPA as one strong representation for control/interaction hazards with explicit limits and complementary analyses.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: STPA terminology/diagrams are not universal properties.

PROPERTIES.PROPERTY_NAME: Resilience or adaptation terminology without hazard, control or decision specificity
PROPERTIES.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Resilience engineering and Safety-II discourse when reduced to broad capacity/positive-performance language.
PROPERTIES.ORIGINAL_FORM: Invoke resilience, adaptation, flexibility or “work as done” as a safety property without defining the loss, boundary, control, feedback or measurable decision.
PROPERTIES.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Vague desirable language cannot discriminate safe from unsafe adaptation and may legitimise migration or under-specified continuation.
PROPERTIES.LOSS_OR_HAZARD: Loss after adaptation exceeded safety constraints, or resources were spent on unmeasurable capacity claims rather than concrete controls.
PROPERTIES.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Construct ambiguity, inconsistent indicators, retrospective success stories, survivorship bias and absent authority/stop boundaries.
PROPERTIES.MECHANISM: Retain adaptive monitoring, graceful degradation, local rationality and recovery only when tied to explicit hazards, constraints, feedback, authority and evaluation.
PROPERTIES.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Relevant for variable environments and surprise where bounded adaptation is necessary and observable.
PROPERTIES.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Do not create a resilience programme for a simple deterministic hazard; use the direct control.
PROPERTIES.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Defined loss/constraint, observable adaptive capacity, authority envelope, fallback and evidence that adaptation does not externalise risk.
PROPERTIES.AUTHORITY_OR_CONTROL_PRECONDITIONS: Operators need discretion within bounded authority plus escalation/stop support; adaptation beyond the envelope requires re-assurance.
PROPERTIES.REQUIRED_FEEDBACK_OR_OBSERVABILITY: Envelope excursions, successful/failed adaptations, resource reserve, recovery time, control state and adverse side effects.
PROPERTIES.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Specific adaptive properties can be valuable; generic terminology has no general decision payoff.
PROPERTIES.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Operations, human factors, resilience/safety management and system authority.
PROPERTIES.KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Buzzword adoption, unvalidated indices, romanticising frontline coping, shifting design burden to operators and measuring only successful adaptation.
PROPERTIES.IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Systematic reviews report fragmented indicators and conceptual ambiguity; resilience theory also usefully redirects attention to variability and successful performance.
PROPERTIES.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Evolved toward bounded runtime assurance, explicit adaptive envelopes, recovery metrics and integration with hazard/control models.
PROPERTIES.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: CONTESTED as a standalone general property; admit only specific, observable and authority-bounded adaptive mechanisms linked to unacceptable loss.
PROPERTIES.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: A resilience workshop, score or vocabulary is not required.

CONSEQUENCE_REVERSIBILITY_PROFILE.CHEAP_PATH: Do not create a resilience programme for a simple deterministic hazard; use the direct control.
CONSEQUENCE_REVERSIBILITY_PROFILE.OVER_CONTROL_FAILURE: Uniform maximal treatment wastes scarce safety attention and can provoke workarounds or unavailable service.
CONSEQUENCE_REVERSIBILITY_PROFILE.MATURE_FORM: CONTESTED as a standalone general property; admit only specific, observable and authority-bounded adaptive mechanisms linked to unacceptable loss.
